jobs.description: Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking highly motivated full-time students to join our Data Science Summer Internship Program. jobs.title: Silicon Operations Manager
jobs.description: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance. Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders. Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work. What you’ll do Arago designs its own SoCs. As Silicon Operations Manager, you will own everything after design, from foundry handoff to volume production. You pick up the chip once front-end and physical design are done, and you are accountable for getting working parts in volume. That means managing the foundry, OSAT partners, and test house; co-designing the package; driving qualification and yield ramp; and owning cost, schedule, and supplier relationships. This is not a coordinator role. You are the technical owner of the path from tapeout to shipped product. Required Skills and Experience 7+ years in semiconductor back-end / NPI, with at least one chip taken to production in a fabless context as the main contact with OSATs and foundries. Direct experience managing OSATs and foundries (e.g. TSMC, GF, Samsung, Amkor, ASE). Solid knowledge of advanced packaging: flip-chip, FCBGA, substrates, and package/die co-design. jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. jobs.title: AI Engineer (Manipulation) H/F
jobs.description: At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on manipulation , you will develop the models that let the Marso robot pick, handle and place real-world loads reliably in customer warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of manipulation models from data collection and training to on-robot evaluation and production deployment. Responsibilities Develop, train and evaluate learning-based manipulation models (pick and place, palletization) that run on the Marso robot. Explore and apply approaches such as imitation learning, reinforcement learning and vision-language-action models. Build the data loop for manipulation: teleoperation or demonstration collection, curation, labeling and dataset extraction from field logs. Integrate models with perception, motion planning and control, working with the Intelligent Robotics and Embedded Software teams. Make sure models stay reliable on the robot and in the field: standardized evaluation, failure analysis and robustness to new loads and environments. Optimize models for embedded deployment (latency, quantization, hardware constraints). Use simulation and real-world tests together to speed up iteration and close the sim-to-real gap. Build internal tools to visualize, replay and debug manipulation behavior and model performance. Profile 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering applied to robotics, including hands-on work on robot manipulation. Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent). Practical experience with at least one of: imitation learning, reinforcement learning or vision-language-action models for manipulation. Experience deploying models on real robots, including under hardware constraints. Solid understanding of manipulation fundamentals: kinematics, grasping, motion planning and control. Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, C++, physics simulators, teleoperation setups, force/torque sensing or logistics applications such as palletization or depalletization. jobs.title: AI Engineer (Perception) H/F
jobs.description: At Marso, as an AI Engineer focused on perception , you will develop the models that let the Marso robot understand its environment: detecting, locating and tracking loads, obstacles and people in warehouses. You will own the full lifecycle of perception models from data quality and training to production reliability. Responsibilities Develop, train and evaluate embedded perception models: object detection, segmentation, pose estimation and scene understanding. Fuse data from multiple sensors (cameras, depth sensors, lidar, IMU) to deliver robust perception in real operating conditions. Define and measure data quality for perception and automate dataset extraction and labeling from field logs. Make sure models stay reliable through every deployment stage from PoCs and field tests to production, including changes in lighting, loads and sites. Optimize models for embedded hardware to meet latency and compute constraints while maintaining the output quality. Set up standardized evaluation and regression testing so that every model release is measurably better. Build internal tools to visualize and debug sensor data, predictions and model performance. Profile 4 to 6 years of experience in AI/ML engineering focused on computer vision or 3D perception, ideally in robotics or autonomous systems. Strong command of Python and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or equivalent). Hands-on experience with 2D and 3D perception: detection, segmentation, pose estimation, point clouds or multi-sensor fusion. Experience deploying perception models to production under hardware constraints. Solid understanding of data pipelines: collection, cleaning, labeling and quality measurement. Nice to have: experience with ROS/ROS2, camera and lidar calibration, synthetic data generation, C++ or perception for logistics environments. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of background. Chez Marso, en tant qu' AI Engine

jobs.description: About Us Condukt is the next-generation compliance platform for financial services, offering an agentic solution powered by real-time data for business identity. Always-on and policy-aware, Condukt enables financial institutions and fintechs to gain actionable insights into business verification - unlocking growth, increasing efficiency, and strengthening compliance. We were founded by former operators and builders with deep experience in banking, payments, and lending. Today, our team spans across London and Porto, bringing together engineers, product owners, and operators from companies like Revolut, Meta, Block (Square), SumUp, American Express, Yandex, Taktile, Vertice and OakNorth. Trusted by leading regulated entities, including Wise, Tide, Mollie, Shift4, Flatpay, and myPOS, Condukt is backed by top investors, including Lightspeed Venture Partners and MMC Ventures. For your first four months, that mission is our hiring plan: you'll own it end to end and deliver it. After that, you might launch a new go-to-market channel or build a new function from scratch. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. jobs.description: Omschrijving Wij zijn op zoek naar een Senior Financial Controller voor Uitvoeringsorganisatie Herstel Toeslagen (UHT) in Utrecht. Binnen de afdeling Control & Risk UHT ga je aan de slag in het team Business Control. De afdeling bestaat uit circa 65 medewerkers, verdeeld over drie teams. Business Control bestaat uit circa 25 tot 30 medewerkers, verdeeld over vijf clusterteams. Als Senior Financial Controller ben je inhoudelijk deskundige op het gebied van financiële rapportages, analyses en Planning & Control. Vanuit Business Control werk je voor één of enkele clusters binnen UHT en fungeer je voornamelijk op tactisch niveau als sparringpartner voor de business. Je stelt nieuwe rapportages op, verbetert bestaande rapportages en bewaakt de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van financiële cijfers. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden Opstellen, bespreken en verbeteren van financiële analyses en rapportages. Uitvoeren van verbandscontroles om de betrouwbaarheid van financiële cijfers te waarborgen. jobs.description: DATA SCIENTIST (H/F) STAGE MASTER II - 6 mois Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? Chez Intescia, nous transformons la donnée en levier de croissance. Leader européen de la Data Intelligence, nous opérons le portefeuille de données et de solutions le plus complet du marché pour aider les entreprises à détecter plus vite les opportunités, mieux comprendre leurs marchés et décider avec impact. Présents en France, en Espagne, en Italie et en Belgique, nous réalisons plus de 75 M€ de chiffre d'affaires et figurons parmi les 50 plus grands acteurs de l'industrie du logiciel et de la data en France. Au quotidien, des milliers d'entreprises s'appuient sur nos solutions pour accélérer leur business. Contexte du stage Les LLMs (Large Language Model) sont des outils efficaces, rapides à prendre en main et généralistes, ce qui en fait un choix technique facile pour une grande partie des projets de traitement du langage naturel. Ils ont supplanté une partie des algorithmes de Data Science plus « classiques ». Cependant, ils ne sont pas exempts de défauts. Ils sont extrêmement coûteux en énergie, coûteux en eaux, coûteux financièrement et ils nécessitent d’importants investissements (création de Data Centers) pour être mis en place. Dans une volonté de contrôle des données produites et utilisées par l’entreprise (et plus largement de toutes données privées), il est important de garantir que les données traitées soient protégées, ce que l’usage de certains LLMs ne garantit pas. Nous venons par ailleurs de vivre en France, une série de canicules les plus importantes de ces dernières décennies, avec des records de température dans de nombreuses villes françaises. Il est nécessaire de prendre des actions pour aller vers des technologies plus sobres en énergie. Par ailleurs, le monde de l’IA connaît une période d’incertitude, avec une course effrénée vers des modèles généralistes de plus en plus gros et de plus en plus glouton

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description: As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will build software that runs on real drones. You will take Auterion’s platform into a specific customer program and make it work on their hardware, for their mission, in the field. This is a software engineering role. You will design, write, integrate and debug C++ and Python code on a Linux-based autonomy stack, working with AuterionOS, our operating system for autonomous vehicles, and Skynode, our flight and mission computer running PX4 and AuterionOS. Your work will span autonomy, computer vision, video streaming and long-range radio links, on partner platforms across aerial, maritime and ground vehicles. What sets this role apart is that your work isn’t finished when the code is merged; it’s finished when the system flies. You will join a forward deployed team dedicated to a single customer program, which owns the outcome from first requirement to deployed system. You will work directly with partners and customers, as well as with Auterion’s core platform, hardware and flight test teams. Between trips, you will work from our Munich office, both at your desk and on the bench. No drone experience is required. If you have integrated software on cars, robots, industrial machines or other embedded systems, you already have the right foundation, and we will teach you the drone side. Responsibilities and Duties Design and implement software for customer programs on AuterionOS and Skynode, including features, integrations, payload and sensor drivers, and tooling. Bring up complete systems on real hardware, including compute, sensors, payloads and radios, and get them working end to end. Debug across the full stack, determining whether an issue stems from software, configuration, hardware or RF, and then resolving it. Translate customer mission requirements into technical solutions and working demonstrations. Work on site with partners and customers to run flight tests, trials and demonstrations, solving problems directly

jobs.description: What’s in it for you (to start with): Gross monthly salary ranging from € 3.600 to € 5.700 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework 8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary. And many more benefits that you can read about at the bottom of the job description! Your challenges: The Creatives team works on and is responsible for our Image Editor and related image-processing features. You will be working on the backend and sometimes a little bit on the frontend of a complex distributed web application. Our tool provides several different services, written in Haskell, Python, and Rust. In this position, you will be responsible for the architecture, development, and maintenance of new and old image-related features in our application. An important aspect of our work is scaling our services to the next level, so we can handle another order of magnitude increase in throughput while keeping our app fast and responsive. To give you a sense of scale: a couple hundred millions of images are inspected, transformed and created by our services every day. Plan and shape the future of the Creatives suite of features with our tight-knit team Design, develop, and test new product features Collaborate with and review PRs of other team members Improve the reliability and robustness of our application Work on scalability and performance improvements Collaborate with our other product and platform teams to integrate image-manipulating features with other parts of our tool. Our Stack includes: Haskell, Python, Rust, PostgreSQL, TypeScript, React, Ansible, Terraform, Prometheus. And we run all of our infrastructure on Go

jobs.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Search Features & APIs (SABR)
jobs.description: About us Launched in 2019, Constructor is an AI-first e-commerce search and discovery platform that helps shoppers find the right products at the right time and enables leading global e-commerce brands to drive meaningful revenue and conversion gains. About the team The SABR team owns the top layer of request processing for product discovery. We own the service that first receives product discovery requests (autocomplete, search, browse & recommendations) & executes the entire business logic that drives product discovery. That service also functions as a gateway to parse incoming user requests, orchestrate calls across the internal services that do the ranking and retrieval, interpret their responses, and assemble the final response the customer sees. We also own the public configuration APIs customers use to control how discovery behaves, and the MCP layer that exposes all of it to AI agents. Our team owns both platform & product components: Because of the positioning of our services, we take part in every architectural decision of our core product offering. At the same time, our goals are heavily influenced by direct customer feedback, because all product discovery-related features are either implemented in or integrated with our services. All of our services are public APIs, so interface design and backward compatibility are a constant part of the job. But most of our attention goes to keeping them fast and up: we serve up to 15k RPS, fan out to many internal services on every request, and are expected to stay available and degrade gracefully when any of them fails or slows down. The work is distributed systems in practice rather than in theory: request orchestration, failure isolation, caching, latency budgets, capacity planning, and the observability to know what is actually happening in production. jobs.description: Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. jobs.description: Principal Product Manager, Agentic AI REMOTE, United States JOB OVERVIEW Legion is building AI agents that carry out workforce management work, not agents that describe it. Much of what is presented as AI in workforce management today is a conversational layer over an existing scheduling screen. The more substantial problem — software that reasons over demand, labor regulation, and employee preferences, then acts, with a person in the loop wherever the stakes require one — remains unsolved across the category. Legion intends to solve it, and this role leads the product work to get there. You will take an agent surface from operational research through specification, prototype, evaluation, and enterprise deployment, working hands-on throughout. You will work closely with Legion's AI Lab engineers and with our CEO, who is engaged in this work daily. RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES Agent definition. Determine what an agent is responsible for, which tools it may call, what it must escalate, what it must never do, and what a manager sees when it acts. These decisions affect employee pay and legal compliance. Much of this work is pre-launch, so you will shape the direction rather than inherit it. Problem selection. The hardest judgment in agentic product work is identifying which workflows suit an agent and which do not. You will spend substantial time inside customer operations — district managers, store managers, labor operations, frontline employees — and return with a ranked, defensible view of where an agent creates measurable value and where it does not. The human-in-the-loop contract. Scheduling decisions affect income, childcare arrangements, and legal protections. For each agent action you will define where autonomy is appropriate, the escalation thresholds, how a manager overrides the system, what is logged, and how a compliance team audits the outcome. jobs.description: Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity. About the Role The Exploration Company builds the TEC vehicle family and is preparing the next generation of vehicles and products. As a Senior Avionics Engineer in the Future Systems team, you will be the system engineer who turns future mission concepts into credible, well-defined avionics, communications and power architectures. You will bring a solid working expertise in electrical power systems, data handling and communications, and you will shape designs that are ready to be challenged, tested and flown. You will work closely with the other engineering disciplines, and you will report to the Principal Engineer of the project. Key Responsibilities Own work packages or full future projects in avionics, communications and power, from concept through verification, delivering on time, on quality and on cost. Define functional breakdowns and high-level requirements , flow them down to avionics subsystems, and manage the associated technical baselines so the design meets the needs of each project. Develop system architectures and conceptual designs , perform avionics-related technical trade-offs, and carry out budget and performance analyses (power, mass, data, thermal interfaces). Write development, implementation, verification and validation plans , and drive them through to completion with the teams involved. Develop hardware solutions for future projects, from requirements to integration and test support. What we would love to see from you In this role, ideally, you will have the following: Proven hands-on experience in designing electrical systems for spacecraft or other aerospace platforms, with a clear record of delivering them. A broad understanding of the full functional chain of space-based avionics, communications and power systems, and how the pieces interact. Here at The Exploration Company we are developing, producing, and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable space orbital vehicle that can eventually be refueled in orbit, and which carries cargo - and potentially humans in the longer run. As a Senior Navigation Sensors engineer, you will support the integration and testing of the Nyx navigation sensors – Inertial measurement Unit (IMU), GNSS Receiver, Star Tracker and LiDAR – ensuring seamless integration and performance of the Navigation Sensing Suite (NSS) functional chain. jobs.description: Who We Are AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint. We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel. We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build. We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community. jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early. Your Day-to-Day Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV). Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths. Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality

jobs.description: About Atlantic Atlantic is the first believer in founders, science and bold ideas. We lead pre-seed rounds across Europe with speed and conviction, backing ambitious founders from day one and supporting them hands-on, especially with fundraising and hiring. As a thesis-driven fund, we have built deep expertise in four technology areas: AI & Compute, Energy & Climate, Industrial & Robotics, and Space & Security. You'll report directly to our Head of Finance and work closely with our Partners, our fund administrator and our tax advisor. Beyond the day-to-day, you’ll have a clear mandate to automate. The goal is to cut manual work in half and let portfolio insights surface on their own. If building the finance function of a modern VC sounds better than maintaining one, read on. What you'll own Automation. You develop our existing setup, and automate finance and administrative workflows wherever it adds value. Portfolio monitoring. You collect the reporting from our 150+ portfolio companies and use AI to turn the data into insights that the team can act on. Cash flow and invoicing. You manage liquidity planning, management fees and invoicing across our funds and management company, and support capital calls and distributions. Fund accounting and reporting. jobs.description: Optimisation de l’implantation de l’offre de soins en zones rurales Organisme d’accueil : Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) – IMT Mines Albi Le Centre de Génie Industriel (CGI) développe des activités d’enseignement et de recherche autour de la modélisation, du pilotage et de l’amélioration des systèmes industriels et organisationnels, dans des contextes complexes et incertains (industrie du futur, supply chain, résilience, etc.). Contexte et missions Les inégalités territoriales d’accès aux soins constituent un enjeu majeur des politiques publiques de santé en France. Elles sont particulièrement marquées dans les territoires ruraux et isolés, caractérisés par une faible densité de population, des distances importantes aux services de santé et une démographie médicale parfois fragile. Dans ces territoires, l’amélioration de l’accès aux soins ne repose pas uniquement sur l’augmentation du nombre de professionnels de santé, mais également sur leur localisation et leur organisation territoriale. Dans le cadre du projet de recherche MAillage Territorial pour Améliorer l’Accès aux soins dans les zones Rurales et Isolées (MATAARI), l’objectif est de développer des méthodes d’optimisation permettant de concevoir de nouvelles organisations territoriales de l’offre de soins, en tenant compte des contraintes géographiques, démographiques et médicales. Les indicateurs actuellement utilisés pour caractériser l’accès aux soins, notamment l’Accessibilité Potentielle Localisée (APL) développée par la DREES [1], permettent de prendre en compte simultanément la demande de soins, l’offre médicale et la distance entre les populations et les professionnels de santé. Aujourd’hui, ces indicateurs sont principalement utilisés à des fins de diagnostic et de caractérisation des territoires. L’enjeu de ce stage sera de les intégrer dans un problème d’optimisation afin de déterminer les conditions nécessaires à l’amélioration de l’accessibilité aux soins. jobs.title: Machine Learning & AI Internship
jobs.description: WHY this position is important Pennylane builds the financial management and accounting platform used by SMEs and accounting firms in France, Germany and Spain. As a product-led company, we invest first in the product, and AI is now at the core of it. The ML & AI team (about thirty people in Paris, part of the Data organisation) builds the AI inside the product. Its first priority is Autopilot : automated accounting production with the accountant in control. Autopilot reads documents, books entries, matches bank transactions, reviews client files and prepares VAT returns with as little human intervention as possible. These tasks raise real ML problems. Answers must be exact, every client is different, accounting constraints can be checked automatically, and we have millions of real examples corrected by accountants. This internship is a chance to work on one of these problems with real data, real users and a direct path to production. HOW you will contribute You will join the ML & AI team, within a Tech organisation of more than 400 people. You will work on one main topic for the whole internship, protected from day-to-day work, with a dedicated tutor. Every topic follows the same path: Evaluation first : in the first weeks, you agree with your tutor on a frozen evaluation set and the metrics that matter. A baseline in production : you ship a simpler first version that the team can put into production, around months 1 to 3. Then go further : you improve it and explore more advanced approaches. Research topics are designed to lead to a publishable result. You will own the topic end to end: understanding the problem with accountants and product teams, defining success metrics, building, measuring and presenting your results. Topics for 2027 Here is an overview of the topics we want to staff in 2027. We agree on the final topic and your tutor with you. jobs.title: Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, UGV Platforms (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Quantum Systems is a leading European deep-tech company for unmanned systems across air, land and maritime domains. We develop and scale integrated hardware, software and AI-powered solutions for mission-critical operations. By combining autonomous platforms with intelligent software and AI, Quantum Systems enables customers to operate, understand and act across domains. Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real world operations. As Senior E/E Engineer EMC and Compliance, you will own electromagnetic compatibility across our UGV platforms, starting with our Mandrill UGV: from the grounding and shielding concept on the drawing board to the certificate that puts our vehicles on public roads and into military service. Your goal is one robust E/E design baseline that passes civil homologation (UN ECE R10) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461, AECTP 500) without costly redesign loops. This is a senior engineer role with real ownership and room to grow. You build our EMC capability from the ground up, set the strategy, decide early in the design, and lead campaigns through to certification. You will work at the intersection of high power electronics, vehicle E/E, radios and mission payloads, autonomy compute, suppliers, test houses and authorities. As the platform family and team grow, this role can develop into leading our EMC and compliance function. What is your Day to Day Mission: EMC Strategy and Compliance Ownership Define and own the EMC and E3 compliance strategy for our UGV platforms, covering civil vehicle approval (UN ECE R10, E mark for vehicle and ESA) and military qualification (MIL-STD-461G, MIL-STD-464, AECTP 500 / AECTP 250, MIL-STD-1275). Translate customer, NATO and national requirements into an EMC control plan, requirement matrix and test strategy, and keep them current as configurations evolve. Act as the technical interface to accredited test houses, technical services, type approval authorities and defence customers

Bufab Flos is gevestigd aan het Flight Forum in Eindhoven, midden in de innovatieve Brainport-regio. Vanuit hier werken we samen voor onze klanten in innovatieve sectoren zoals Automotive, Mechanical Engineering en Mechatronics. Van sourcing en inkoop tot kwaliteitsbewaking, opslag en levering. In alles wat we doen staat één doel centraal: onze klanten maximaal ontzorgen door meerwaarde te bieden op het gebied van techniek, kwaliteit en logistiek. Ons uitgangspunt is daarbij helder: afspraak is afspraak. Met 140 betrokken collega’s vormen we een divers en internationaal team. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. More than 600,000 professionals across 3,000+ organizations in 175 countries rely on DataSnipper, including Fortune 500 companies, government agencies and all Big Four audit firms. jobs.description: Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us. New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now. Two ways to work with clients Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it. Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process. Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own. What you get Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences. Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours. No micromanagement, no screen trackers Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries Who we’re looking for Senior React & Python Developers with: 5+ years of software development experience. Commercial experience: React.js 3+ years & Python 3+ years OR React.js 2+ years & Python 5+ years OR React.js 5+ years & Python 2+ years Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required. jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description: Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating. We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you. jobs.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
jobs.description: Job Title: Patient Care Advocate Job Location: Remote About Us: We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. Role Overview: As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. What You’ll Do: Patient Enrollment & Eligibility : Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. Prescription Coverage : Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. Cost-Sharing & Payment : Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. Prescription Fulfillment : Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. Refills & Continued Use : Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. Program Renewal & Updates : Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. jobs.description: We’re looking for a pragmatic, security-minded Full-Stack Developer to help build and scale Fluence’s B2B products used by clinicians, researchers, and organizations in psychedelic-assisted therapy and mental health. You’ll work closely with and report to our Senior AI & Design Lead to turn product requirements into robust, secure, and well-documented applications, as well as maintain existing ones. What you’ll do Build and maintain full-stack web applications using React and Next.js . Architect reliable, performant backends and APIs; familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/Fargate, API Gateway, RDS/DynamoDB, S3, CloudFront, Cognito, etc.) is important. AWS Bedrock and AWS CloudTrail experience is a plus. Implement secure authentication, authorization, and role-based access for clinician, admin, and other user workflows. Design data models and flows with privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations in mind. Integrate with internal and external APIs and third-party services used in our B2B stack. Experience with LLM/AI features in production (guardrails, logging, security considerations). Implement logging, monitor performance, and ship production-quality code. Datadog and Sentry experience is a plus. Collaborate directly with the Senior AI & Design Lead for clear ownership, feedback, and iteration. Maintain clear documentation of architecture, decisions, and interfaces for internal teams. (Bonus) Use Convex or similar BaaS / serverless data platforms for rapid product delivery. (Bonus) Build and maintain n8n workflows (webhooks, scheduled jobs, error workflows, credential management, self-hosting) to automate internal operations and connect our product stack.
